notes.title: Boreas Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
Hey sailors,

It’s been quite a while since our last update, but we’ve got a good reason for this ‘calm before the storm’: we’ve been hard at work improving the game! And now, we’re ready to announce that the DEMO OUT NOW!

TL;DR. If that’s all you wanted to know – great! But if you’re curious about what’s new, keep reading for more details:

Complete Game Rework

We’ve reimagined the core concept of the game. Why? Because we wanted it to feel more fun and relaxing. Our aim is for you to enjoy the serene experience of sailing across the sea, connecting with islanders, and exploring without unnecessary stress. Expect pure chill and relaxation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333345/adb1e322f25a67e382b31313a38ae311eae8e568.gif

Visual Overhaul

After experimenting with countless ship designs, we’ve finally chosen one that fits the world perfectly – both aesthetically and practically.

And here’s another exciting update: while sailing, you’ll now encounter friendly sea creatures! Be sure to say hello, they’ll appreciate it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333345/ac601b229daa0e4f64d016998d483e2111899286.gif

Quest System

As you sail, you’ll come across items floating in the sea. These will serve as fuel for your ship or valuable trade goods for the islanders.

In the demo, you’ll explore multiple islands, each inhabited by locals. Some will have quests for you, while others will be happy to trade. The more you help the islanders, the better their islands will thrive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333345/45e750ea2e00213d21e3c1e55757849b6b998013.gif

Check out the new trailer 

Ready to set sail? Play the demo and let us know what you think — your feedback will help shape the journey ahead!
